title: AIAS Cyber Level
description: AIAS conference demo M2. The citizen presents their Assured Identity credential to prove entitlement, answers an eight-question cyber-hygiene questionnaire, and an autonomous agent scores the answers into a band and issues a Cyber Level credential carrying the level plus the portrait mapped forward from the verified presentation. The issuing-agency name is injected via the {{issuerName}} token at provision time.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: AIAS Cyber Level
template.description: Present your Assured Identity, answer eight questions about your cyber habits, and receive a leveled Cyber Level credential.

metadata.features: OpenID4VP, Credential Presentation Gate, Optional Claims, Slider Inputs, Autonomous Scoring, Verifiable Credential, Portrait Carry-Forward

participants.name: Credential Holder
participants.description: Holds an AIAS Assured Identity credential and is applying for a Cyber Level

participants.name: AIAS Cyber Analyst
participants.description: The autonomous Cyber-mode agent that scores the questionnaire and issues the leveled credential

actions.title: Your cyber health check
actions.description: Present your Assured Identity credential to prove it is yours, then answer eight quick questions about how you look after your accounts and devices.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Eight questions about your cyber habits. Answer honestly — AIAS is scoring your actual posture, not your good intentions.

passwordStorage.title: How do you keep track of your passwords?
enum: The same one everywhere, and hope

emailSecondStep.title: Is there a second step when you sign in to your email?
enum: Yes — an app or a hardware key
Yes — a code by text message

passwordChangeHabit.title: How often do you change your passwords?
enum: Only when I think one's been exposed
Once a year, whether it needs it or not

phoneUpdates.title: Your phone offers an update. What happens?
enum: I install it within a few days
There's a red badge I've been ignoring since spring

suspiciousEmail.title: An email says your bank account is locked. What do you do?
enum: Ignore the email and open the bank's app myself
Check the sender address carefully, then decide
Hover the link to see where it goes, then decide

laptopLoss.title: If your laptop vanished this afternoon, what would you lose?
enum: I copied things to a USB stick once

sharedPasswordCount.title: How many of your accounts share a password?

streamingPasswordSharers.title: How many people know your streaming password?

holderKeys.title: Your holder key
holderKeys.description: Your wallet's holder public key (web-issued). Captured automatically and read-only — the credential is bound to your wallet's holder key (standard OID4VP holder binding, #1195) and encrypted to your wallet so only you can present it.

routes.description: Answers submitted — hand to the AIAS cyber analyst for scoring

actions.title: AIAS scores your answers
actions.description: The AIAS cyber analyst scores the questionnaire, maps the total to a level band, and issues a Cyber Level credential carrying the level and the portrait from the presented Assured Identity.

x-decision-notice.title: AIAS could not award your Cyber Level

reasons.no-portrait: AIAS cannot issue a Cyber Level without a face to put on it. Add a photo to your Assured Identity and come back.
reasons.cyber-fail: AIAS admires the honesty, but cannot certify this. Your overall cyber hygiene needs work across the board — tighten up your habits and try again.

x-decision-notice.fallbackMessage: AIAS could not award a Cyber Level on this occasion.
